#Make map 
```{r}

getwd()
setwd("/Users/eliza/Desktop/FINAL 2025/mapping ")

##### Load required packages

library(rworldmap)
library(sp)
library(sf)
library(cartography)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggdensity)
library(ggforce)

##### Bring in raw data file for nesting locations

nesting.locations <- read.csv("locations_individual.csv", header = TRUE)

##### Basemaps 

canada_basemap <- map_data("world") %>% 
  filter(region == "Canada")

mexico_basemap <- map_data("world") %>% 
  filter(region == "Mexico")

######## REDO IT ##################

BOW <- st_read("BOW_lines.shp")
BOW <- BOW %>% filter(adm0_a3 %in% c("CAN", "USA"))
usa <- st_read("usa_canada.shp")
mexico_states <- st_read("mexico_states.shp")
lakes <- st_read("North_America_Major_Lakes.shp")

map <- ggplot() +  theme_bw() + 
  #Add in the canada background layer
  geom_polygon(data=canada_basemap, aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group), 
               fill="grey90", color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
   geom_polygon(data=mexico_basemap, aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group), 
               fill="grey90", color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
   # Background map for USA 
  geom_sf(data=usa, fill="grey90", color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
  geom_sf(data=lakes, fill="white", color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
 # Boundary lines 
  geom_sf(data=BOW, color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
   # Boundary lines 
  geom_sf(data=mexico_states, color="white", linewidth=0.35) +
  # Nesting locations as points
  geom_point(data = nesting.locations,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
    fill = Ecosystem_condensed
  ),
  size = 2,
  shape = 21,
  stroke = 1,
  color = "black"
) +
  # Axis labels
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude") +
  # Theme tweaks
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text = element_text(size=8)) +  
  # Modify the Y-axis to remove "degrees N"
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  # Modify X-axis (Longitude)
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  # Proper map coordinate system
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-165.5, -60), ylim = c(27.5, 71), expand=FALSE)


map

ggsave("map_final2.pdf", plot = map, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")


```

#Make violin plot for sex
```{r}





getwd()

library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(ggeffects)


final <- read.csv("full.csv")

sex <- ggplot(final, aes(x=Sex, y=Est)) + geom_violin(trim=TRUE, alpha= 0.2)  +theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Removes major grid lines
   panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # Removes minor grid lines
  panel.background = element_blank()) + # Ensures no panel background

  geom_jitter(width=0.2, height=0, color="coral4", shape=16, size=3, fill = "white") + ylab("95% AKDE Home Range Size (km^2)") 
sex


####geom_sina

sex <- ggplot(final, aes(x = Sex, y = Est)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_sina(
    aes(color = Sex), 
    size = 3, 
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("95% AKDE Home Range Size (km^2)")

sex

ggsave("sex_final3.pdf", plot = sex, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")



nrow(final)

```
